about: A tool that draws database diagrams from dbt projects.

prs.title: A fresh install of dbterd runs
prs.broken: dbterd needed a package it never listed, so a clean install failed on every command with a missing module error. The project's own tests did not notice.
prs.changed: The missing package is now listed as a requirement, so it installs with dbterd.
prs.matters: New users can install the tool and run it right away.
